schedule.intro: Classes run in two shifts. Each lesson is 45 minutes with a 5-minute break between lessons.

faq.intro: Answers to questions parents often ask. Tap a question to see the answer.

items.a: Shift 1 starts at 08:00 and shift 2 at 13:00. Each lesson lasts 45 minutes with a 5-minute break between lessons.

items.q: Which grades study in which shift?
items.a:
Shift 1: grades 1, 2, 5, 9, 10 and 11.
Shift 2: grades 3, 4, 6, 7 and 8.

items.q: Where can I see my child’s timetable?
items.a: On the Timetable page, pick the shift, grade and class — the daily and weekly timetable opens.

items.q: Where can I see grades and homework?
items.a: Grades, attendance and homework are in the eMaktab.uz electronic diary. Ask your child's homeroom teacher for login details.

items.q: How can I contact the school?
items.a: Phone: +998 90 970 90 91 (Monday – Saturday, 09:00 – 17:30). Address: Qiziriq district, Surkhandarya region.

items.q: How do I send a question or suggestion?
items.a: Fill in the form on the Contact page and it will reach the school administration. For urgent matters, please call.
